description: The chart is a doughnut chart comparing the proportions of two categories, labeled "Ambiguity" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)", across three subcategories. The chart is divided into six slices, with three slices for each category. For "Ambiguity", the slices are labeled as "Deceived" (red, 67.6%), "Partially" (yellow, 31.6%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 10.5%), while for "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)", the slices are labeled as "Deceived" (red, 57.9%), "Partially" (yellow, 23.5%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 8.8%). The chart includes two legends, one for each category, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered by size, with the largest slice being "Deceived" for both categories.
